title: BUGFIX — CaptionAgent: resolve outputDir to absolute path to fix ffmpeg subtitles filter
rationale: In agents/scs001-caption/index.ts the CaptionAgent constructor has a relative default outputDir ('workspace/scs001/caption-outputs'). When the orchestrator calls new CaptionAgent(this.workDir + '/caption'), this.workDir is also relative. The resulting srtPath passed to ffmpeg's subtitles filter is relative, which causes 'Error parsing filterchain' / 'No option name near' failures when ffmpeg's cwd differs from the kognai root. Fix: call resolve() on outputDir in the constructor to always produce an absolute path. The fallback (copyFileSync) still protects production, but this fix makes subtitle burn-in reliable across cwd contexts.

tasks.description: In agents/scs001-caption/index.ts: (1) import { resolve } from 'path'. (2) In constructor, replace `this.outputDir = outputDir` with `this.outputDir = resolve(outputDir)`. This ensures srtPath and captionedPath are always absolute, making the ffmpeg subtitles=f='...' filter work regardless of process cwd.
